subject.title: fix: keep tail alive and replay timed-out messages

question: Should Discrawl adopt this fail-closed tail contract, including fatal detached ordered timeouts, durable filesystem fallback state, and bounded automatic exact-message replay?
rationale: Tests establish the implemented invariants, but the choice changes live message ordering and operator recovery semantics in a high-impact archival path; repository intent is required before landing.

options.title: Accept the recovery contract
options.body: Merge after an area owner confirms that the timeout, fallback, replay, and delete semantics are the intended long-term behavior.

options.title: Narrow the patch
options.body: Keep durable failure recording but defer automatic replay or the replay-only CLI surface to a separate change.

options.title: Retain current behavior
options.body: Do not merge and continue treating these timeout cases as fatal without durable exact-message recovery.

recommendation.title: Accept the recovery contract
recommendation.body: Merge after an area owner confirms that the timeout, fallback, replay, and delete semantics are the intended long-term behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history connects this owner to syncer cancellation, storage reliability, and the central code paths changed here.
